note: Inkling 2 Mini on one DGX Spark (TP=1), engine install/atlas-source.json. BF16 KV, 8 concurrent requests of up to 131,072 tokens each, at utilization 0.80, prefill chunks of 4,096 tokens (on the 0.2.0 image a 32K-token prompt took 10.0 s against 11.3 s at 2,048; a longer chunk also holds other requests' decode steps longer), programmatic dependent launch for the engine's Inkling kernels. The launcher adds the DSpark drafter (DRAFTER).
